items.text: Anyone else struggling to get a job with a CRC? 😫

Hi everyone!
I figured I’d put myself out there because this job search is definitely teaching me patience lol!

I recently graduated with Honors from DeVry’s Medical Billing & Coding program and officially passed my CPC exam, so I’m now a CPC-A! 🎉 

I also have several years of experience in healthcare administration, billing, patient registration, and dental management, so while I’m new to coding professionally, I’m definitely not new to the healthcare world.

Right now, I’m looking for someone willing to give a new coder that first opportunity to get her foot in the door! I’m open to entry-level medical coding positions, preferably remote, and I’m ready to learn, work hard, and grow.

I’d also love to hear from those of you who started as a CPC-A — how did you land your first coding job? Because whewww, getting the certification was one thing, getting someone to give you that first chance is looking like a whole different adventure 😂

And of course, if there are any recruiters or hiring managers here looking for a new coder, I’d love to connect! ❤️

For anyone trying to break into medical billing on their own: I put together a free 5-page starter sample from my ebook. It covers what a freelance biller actually does day to day, the skills you need, and how to land your first client. No cost, no sign-up — link's in the first comment. Happy to answer questions below.

Has anyone taken the CPC exam at home??
What did you have to change in the room to make it acceptable to the proctor? I’ve looked at their website but other people have said they are a lot more strict. If you guys could help that would be great!! I am taking it this Friday your help would be great.

topComments.text: I put a sheet over my tv and had to have the door closed. Everything else was ok. If you scheduled the demo test first, they will have you scan the room, preapprove everything, help you place the camera etc. it took a lot of stress off me for the actual test.

I passed my CPC exam in November 2024 at home and it was so stressful for me that I have another test coming up for my CDEO and I’m taking it in person. I had a classmate who tried to take theirs at home and had connection issues and they lost out on a testing voucher and didn’t get to reschedule. They had to repurchase a new voucher

items.text:
Hi everyone! 😊
I’m based in South Africa and I’m currently looking for remote medical coding opportunities. I’m an AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC) and I’m currently completing my Practicode to gain additional hands-on coding experience.

I’m specifically looking for companies that hire medical coders remotely from South Africa, including international companies that are open to offshore candidates.

If anyone knows of any companies, recruiters, or job boards currently hiring remote medical coders in South Africa, I would really appreciate it if you could share them with me! 🙏

I’m also open to entry-level opportunities and willing to work US/offshore hours.

Thank you so much in advance for any recommendations or leads! ❤️

topComments.text: I don’t know of a single company that hires remotely out of the country. They all say resident of US and physically in the US.

items.text:
Hello everyone!
I was wondering if anybody had any information as far as pay scale for coders in different states or preferably in Michigan or Ohio. I had went to school for billing and coding and I was certified, but let my certificate expire and ended up in the billing field at a local hospital. 

I currently make $25 an hour billing in Ohio. I am looking to take another course and get CPC certified to go back into coding. I just want to make sure that it’s worth the money! 

TIA 🥰

topComments.text:
Honestly, most of the positions I’ve seen range from $19-$25/hour but those are for Coder 1 positions. I’m not sure where you would end up in terms of experience after getting the cert and if you’d have the qualifications to apply for Coder 2 jobs! But those seem to be $22-24+ an hour. And if you can get into a specialty, maybe more? Honestly might be more worth it to get the CCS thru AHIMA 🥲 I tend to see it listed as a requirement more often than CPC.

This is info pulled from rigorous amounts of job hunting and applying in Ohio lol; I just got my CPC-A in July. If you’ve got any leads on work I’d love to hear about them 😵‍💫 Best of luck tho! ⭐️

items.text: Am I allowed to post job openings in here?

topComments.text:
Yes! I think they just don’t allow anything pertaining to selling books or book codes.

If it’s a CPC-A friendly job sign me up lol! Either way, you should be all good to post job openings. 👍

items.text: 👋 hello new here. Just getting ready to begin my journey to become a CPC. Any advice for someone starting from the beginning? I’m doing self study and plan on testing through AAPC. All the information on here so far had been so helpful.

topComments.text: Make sure to read and go over guidelines! Coding can be fun, but lots of time ppl forget the fundamentals leading them to having trouble when skipping over the basics. You do not have to memorize them; but you must know how and where to find them. 😊 get to know your books.

items.text: Is there anyone in the Huntington West Virginia area that provides tutoring?? I have failed my exam 5x now and I don’t know where I’m going wrong!

I PASSED ON MY FIRST TRY!
I’m usually a terrible test taker but I’m so proud of myself. I studied my butt off! 

I saw someone on here help with resumes, can someone point me in the right direction??

topComments.text: Thats awesome.. congratulations 🎊 all your hard work shows. Great job!!!

topComments.text: You have to take the classes and then get the certificate.

items.text:
Aged AR doesn’t get better by waiting.

Every untouched denial is a claim that still needs attention — and the longer it sits, the harder it can become to recover in full.

The difference is what happens next:

Review. Work. Resolve.

A clean AR isn’t about letting claims sit until someone has time. It’s about having a process that keeps them moving.

How much aged AR is currently sitting untouched in your practice?
